name: Grand Prix du Morbihan
story: An early breakaway of three riders led the race until the peloton caught them with four laps remaining. Late attacks by Daniel Cavia and Simen Evertsen-Hegreberg also failed, setting up a sprint finish. After a strong lead-out for Clément Venturini, Benoît Cosnefroy edged out Noa Isidore to claim his fourth Grand Prix du Morbihan victory.
